_comment: Reference for the SHIPPED production supervisor-config.json (written by macos/scripts/stage-app-bundle.sh). Every bundle path is Contents/ — relative (resolved against the installed app bundle derived from the supervisor's own executable — install-location independent); app_support_dir/log_dir are ABSENT (the supervisor applies the per-user ~/Library defaults at load). Origins: tauri://localhost is the embedded first-run page origin; http://127.0.0.1:3001 is the API-served frontend origin (first-run fix, acceptance/FIRST-RUN-ROOT-CAUSE.md); http://localhost:3000 is the static-export dev shape. frontend_dir is the static export the API serves at its own origin (MEDIVAULT_STATIC_DIR). CI harnesses may pass an explicit --config with absolute paths — both forms are supported by config.rs.
